caption: The drawing displays a basket-shaped bowl shown from two perspectives: a top view and a side view. The object features a prominent curved handle, colored in a deep red, extending from one side of the bowl's rim to the other. The rim of the bowl beneath the handle is decorated with red floral motifs and connective swirls distributed evenly around the circumference. The body of the bowl is presented in a light coloration, resembling either white or a pale off-white, with vertical red lines running from the rim to the rounded base. The base itself is circular and echoes the red shade. The drawing is positioned within a rectangular border centered on a beige background. The artist's signature, "G. Lemberg," appears near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Basket
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
